minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved the quarterly billing commitment and discussed a manhole overflow, a business manager resignation and MUNIS billing problems.
minutes.summary: The commission heard about a Sunday-night sewer manhole overflow on Sunset Avenue caused by a cracked pressure fitting, repaired by the contractor. It approved two sets of prior minutes, the quarterly billing commitment, and adding the business manager's resignation letter to the minutes. Most of the meeting dealt with the business manager's departure, filling commission vacancies, the manhole repair bid, and continuing MUNIS software errors.

public_comment.topic: Call for public comment: no general public present; commissioners and staff used the time to thank the departing sewer business manager.
A prospective commission member (heard as Scott Foreman) joined remotely to observe; no remarks recorded.

votes.motion: Approve the Q1 sewer usage billing commitment in the stated amount

budget_items.topic: Manhole repair IFB / select board allocation
budget_items.what_was_said: The select board granted money for manhole repairs the prior year and the commission wants it kept; the bid must go out soon so a contract is in hand by November.
The quarterly usage billing commitment was stated and approved by the commission.
Speakers guessed at the annual cost of the MUNIS contract to the town, recalling a figure said to the select board.
The commission's request included funds to cover the cost of the consultant, and the finance director did as well.
Staff will price spare parts to keep on the shelf at the DPW after the fitting failure.

decisions.decision: Staff to get prices and buy spare pressure-system fittings to keep at the DPW.
Business manager to look into the charter on whether the commission has input on hiring the new business manager; a commissioner volunteered to be involved.
Business manager will send out grease trap permit renewals before she leaves and prepare a project list before the August 27 meeting.
Next meetings set for August 27, September 10, September 24 and October 8.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission approved the first-quarter sewer usage billing commitment, in the amount as stated at the meeting.
It voted to add the business manager's resignation letter to the minutes; the manager will send out grease trap permit renewals before she leaves.
Commissioners heard that a Sunset Avenue manhole overflowed after a pressure fitting cracked; the contractor repaired it, and staff will price spare fittings for the DPW.
The manhole repair bid is to go out soon so a contract is in hand by November, and the commission wants the select board's earlier allocation kept.
Continuing MUNIS billing errors were discussed, along with funds in the commission's request to cover a consultant to fix them.

why_it_matters: Sewer usage bills depend on the quarterly commitment and on the MUNIS billing software, so the continuing errors and the business manager's departure bear on how accurately and reliably residents are billed.
The manhole repair work rests on money the select board granted the prior year, and the commission wants that money kept; whether it is kept decides how much of the repair bid is covered.
watch_next: The next meeting on August 27, where the departing business manager is to bring a project list.
The manhole repair bid (IFB), which is to go out soon so a contract is in hand by November.
